title: Microsoft Edge: Enhanced Autofill adds passports and driver's licences on desktop
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, identity-document blocking policy, registry setting and personal-account exclusion are supported. One minor correction remains: the checklist asks administrators to review the deprecated address-autofill control, but that control has no table row.

claims.claim: Group Policy exposes the control at Administrative Templates > Microsoft Edge > Block AutoFill data types for specific sites.
claims.quote:
Group Policy (ADMX) info
GP unique name: AutofillSettings
GP name: Block AutoFill data types for specific sites
GP path (Mandatory): Administrative Templates/Microsoft Edge

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The registry configuration is SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge, value AutofillSettings of type REG_SZ.
claims.quote:
Registry settings
Path (Mandatory): SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge
Value name: AutofillSettings
Value type: REG_SZ

claims.where: controls[0].governs; summary; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: AutofillSettings governs identity-document autofill on specified sites using blocked_types with identity_docs.
claims.quote:
Setting this policy allows you to specify which AutoFill data types are blocked on specific URL patterns.
"identity_docs": Blocks filling and saving of identity documents (for example, passports, driver's licenses, and national IDs).

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: The identity_docs data type includes passports, driver's licences and national IDs that can be filled and saved.
claims.quote: "identity_docs": Blocks filling and saving of identity documents (for example, passports, driver's licenses, and national IDs).

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: AutofillSettings blocks both filling and saving the listed data types on matching URL patterns.
claims.quote:
Setting this policy allows you to specify which AutoFill data types are blocked on specific URL patterns.
"identity_docs": Blocks filling and saving of identity documents

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: When AutofillSettings is not configured, no AutoFill data types are blocked by domain.
claims.quote: If you don't configure this policy, no AutoFill data types are blocked by domain.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Using identity_docs with url_pattern '*' blocks that type on all URLs, with any scheme, port and path.
claims.quote:
The wildcard * is supported and matches any URL with any scheme, port, and path.
Example registry value: {"blocked_types": ["identity_docs"], "url_pattern": "*"}

claims.claim: Edge 156 release notes list AutofillAddressEnabled as deprecated.
claims.quote:
Deprecated policies
AutofillAddressEnabled - Enable AutoFill for addresses (deprecated)

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: AutofillAddressEnabled remains supported at present.
claims.quote: DEPRECATED: This policy is deprecated. It is currently supported but will become obsolete in a future release.

claims.claim: AutofillAddressEnabled is documented to become obsolete in a future release.
claims.quote: It is currently supported but will become obsolete in a future release.

claims.claim: AutofillSettings is a dictionary policy structured as a list of dictionary entries.
claims.quote:
The policy is structured as a list of dictionaries.
Data type
Dictionary

claims.claim: Each AutofillSettings entry contains url_pattern and a blocked_types list.
claims.quote:
Each dictionary must contain:
"url_pattern": A content setting URL pattern for the main frame
"blocked_types": A list of strings representing the categories of AutoFill data to block.

claims.claim: Blocked types from multiple matching URL-pattern entries are combined.
claims.quote: If a URL matches multiple pattern entries in the list, the blocked types from all matching entries are combined.

claims.claim: Narrower URL patterns restrict blocking to matching sites; sites matching no entry are not blocked by this policy.
claims.quote:
Setting this policy allows you to specify which AutoFill data types are blocked on specific URL patterns.
If a URL matches multiple pattern entries in the list, the blocked types from all matching entries are combined.

claims.claim: Blocking a data type disables the prompt to save or import new data of that type on matching sites.
claims.quote: If a data type is blocked for a site, both the generation of suggestions and the prompt to save or import new data of that type are disabled on that site.

claims.where: Governance controls; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Microsoft directs replacing disabled address autofill with AutofillSettings using url_pattern '*' and blocked_types ['contact_info', 'identity_docs', 'travel'].
claims.quote: To keep the current behavior of disabling AutoFill for addresses, configure AutofillSettings with "url_pattern" set to "*" and "blocked_types" set to ["contact_info", "identity_docs", "travel"].

claims.claim: The Enhanced Autofill release-note entry describes document autofill, not an agent or autonomous action.
claims.quote: Enhanced Autofill. For desktop users, Microsoft Edge can now autofill additional document types—including passports, driver's licenses, and other specialized forms—on top of your saved addresses.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Every control the governance checklist asks administrators to review appears in the controls table.
claims.quote: Checklist: "Review any existing use of the deprecated AutofillAddressEnabled policy". The controls table has one row, for AutofillSettings, and none for AutofillAddressEnabled.
claims.fix: Remove the Before rollout checklist bullet beginning 'Review any existing use of the deprecated AutofillAddressEnabled policy'. Keep the verified deprecation and replacement information in Risk assessment and Governance controls; do not add a control row.
